name: Alabama
agencyName: Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (Driver License Division)

applicantVariants.label: Under 18 (GDL Stage I permit / Stage II restricted)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Varies by office (often next business day)

gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 17 (and licensed at least 6 months) for an unrestricted Stage III license
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours of supervised driving or completion of an approved driver education course
gdl.nightCurfew: Stage II: no driving midnight-6 a.m. except for work, school, religious, medical, or emergency reasons
gdl.passengerLimits: Stage II: no more than 1 passenger other than a parent/guardian or family members

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Alabama residential address
process.realIdNotes: Alabama STAR I.D. (REAL ID) requires one document proving identity/legal presence, one proving SSN, and two proving Alabama street address.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye (with or without corrective lenses) for an unrestricted license

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12-14 points in 2 years = 60-day suspension; escalates up to 1 year at 24+ points
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if you cannot safely change lanes, for stopped emergency and recovery vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced posted limit during school hours (commonly 15-25 mph where posted)

verifyNote: ALEA officially confirms fees and GDL ages, but its indexed official pages/manual landing page do not directly state the 30-question/24-correct Class D exam format; retain pending direct official confirmation.
